answers.reasoning: Step 2 runs the updater, step 3 is Object.is(nextState, state), step 4 captures previousState and does the replace-or-merge, then step 5 calls every listener.
useStore passes api.subscribe unchanged plus two memoized readers, selector(api.getState()) and selector(api.getInitialState()), with the selector applied inside those readers.
An explicit replace wins (true=wholesale, false=merge); only when omitted does the type-check fallback apply (non-object/null assigned, object merged one level deep).
The warning box says it was hand-rolled with useReducer+refs until #550 (Apr 2022) switched to the use-sync-external-store shim, then #2301 (Jan 2024) moved to React.useSyncExternalStore directly.
The module says create copies setState, getState, subscribe, and getInitialState onto the hook as own properties via Object.assign(useBoundStore, api).
